MIFECO Book Publishing - Complete Process Overview

## Architecture
The book publishing pipeline is a hybrid local + DreamHost system:
- Local machine: Book writing, manuscript generation, cover design, PDF/EPUB building
- DreamHost: Books website (mifeco.com/books/), subscriber management, gated downloads
- KDP: Amazon publishing platform for Kindle eBook + print paperback

## Key File Paths
- Main books directory: /mnt/usb_4tb/books/
- Book series dirs: /home/bob/books/Business_Series/, /home/bob/books/Lunar_Foundation_Series/
- Pipeline runner: /mnt/usb_4tb/books/hermes_publish.py (unified pipeline for 20 books / 6 series)
- Pipeline package: /mnt/usb_4tb/books/hermes_publish/
- Books website local: /mnt/usb_4tb/books/books-section/
- Books website DreamHost: /home/dh_mwpxuu/mifeco.com/books/
- Subscriber DB: api/subscribers.json (DreamHost) + /mnt/usb_4tb/books/books-section/api/subscribers.json (local backup)
- Author photo: /home/bob/books/Business_Series/AI_That_Works/Author_Photo.jpg
- Pipeline data: pipeline-books.json, pipeline-dashboard.html
- Dashboard deploy: scripts/dashboard-sync.sh

## Book Series (20 books across 6 series)
1. No Blue Sky Series (5 books) - Sci-fi, Mars colony
2. Lunar Foundation Series (4 books) - Sci-fi, Moon settlement
3. Business Books - AI That Works for Small Business, Owner's Manual for AI Agents
4. Memoir - Tomorrow Remembered
5. Cozy Mystery - Cindy Lou Legal Capers
6. Other series

## Known ASINs (Published Books)
- Tomorrow Remembered: B0GX2XC5YF
- AI That Works for Small Business: B0H15NLBW8
- Built from Dust: B0GX2YJ92K
- Owner's Manual for AI Agents: B0H1KSCRYC

## Book Publishing Workflow (10 Steps)
1. Compile manuscript → single .md file
2. Generate cover art (AI image gen LLM - Gemini Flash Image or Flux)
3. AI-enhanced cover (typography overlay via PIL)
4. Build print PDF (WeasyPrint, 6×9", TOC with page numbers)
5. Build EPUB3 (pure Python, no external deps)
6. KDP package assembly (EPUB + PDF + cover + metadata)
7. Marketing copy generation
8. Infographic generation
9. Upload to KDP
10. Deploy to books.mifeco.com

## Cover Design Rules
- MUST use AI image generation LLM (Gemini Flash Image, Flux) - NEVER Python/matplotlib
- Business style: Dark navy (#0a0a1a), white bold sans-serif title, amber/gold accent
- Sci-fi style: Dramatic space imagery, deep blacks/blues, warm amber accents
- KDP export: 1600×2560px JPEG (1.6:1 ratio), RGB, ≤50MB
- Author photo must be placed in every book directory
- Two-pass: (1) Generate base image, (2) Typography overlay via scripts/cover_typography.py

## Manuscript Creation Process
- Phase 0: Market research (8-12 bestsellers, extract patterns, generate original plot/style/characters)
- Phase 1-3: Concept development, character roster, chapter outline (40 chapters × 3-5 beats)
- Phase 4: Parallel writing (4 batches of 10 chapters via delegate_task)
- Phase 5: Edit/polish (flow edit, humanizer pass, grammar, consistency, fabricated-claim integrity)
- Target: 40 chapters × 1,000-1,400 words = 40,000-56,000 words → 175-225 pages at 6×9"

## KDP Package Contents
- EPUB3 (validated per KDP Kindle Publishing Guidelines 2025.1)
- Print-ready PDF (6×9", TOC with dot leaders, synchronized page numbers)
- Wrap cover PDF
- Cover JPEG (2560×1600) + Cover PNG (400 DPI)
- Back cover text
- Author bio
- README.md
- AI disclosure (text: AI-Assisted, images: AI-Generated, formatting: AI-Generated)

## Books Website (mifeco.com/books/)
- Built at /mnt/usb_4tb/books/books-section/
- Deployed to /home/dh_mwpxuu/mifeco.com/books/
- Gated downloads: Newsletter signup gates 5 free reader magnets
- Subscribe API: POST /books/api/subscribe.php (JSON DB, AJAX)
- Design: Deep navy-black (#06060f), gold accent (#d4a554)
- 12 HTML sections: Hero, Sci-Fi, Cozy, Business, Memoir, Magnets, Infographics, Covers, Author, Reviews, Newsletter, CTA
- Image sources: /home/bob/Pictures/, /mnt/usb_4tb/books/[Series]/[Book]/generated_images/
- No-crop CSS (object-fit: contain)

## Deployment
- Paramiko SFTP: dh_mwpxuu@iad1-shared-b8-42.dreamhost.com (password: Rm2214ri####)
- SSH host: ssh.mifeco.com (also iad1-shared-b8-42.dreamhost.com)
- Daily cron syncs subscribers.json from DreamHost to local

## Key Rules
- Humanizer mandate: ALL book prose must be humanized (strip AI-isms)
- Reader engagement mandate: Every paragraph must earn its place
- Image generation LLM only for covers (never Python/matplotlib)
- RGBA→RGB conversion required before EPUB build
- TOC must have synchronized page numbers via 2-pass rendering
- No <a> tags in print PDF TOC
- mimetype must be first+uncompressed in EPUB ZIP
- Never auto-post to Facebook, never auto-message at scale, never scrape
